title: Home Delivery Pharmacy and Specialty Pharmacy Program: Payment Plan Length for Members Owing Specialty Balances
content:
## Cross-benefit coordination note: specialty balances and plan length

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, a plan is lengthened when the member also owes Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy: by two months when the balance due on the member's active specialty enrollment is 500.00 or more, by one month when that balance is above zero but under 500.00, and not at all when nothing is owed there.

The balance read is the balance due on the member's active Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment.

### Lengthening by specialty balance

| Balance due on the active Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment | Plan lengthened by |
|---|---|
| 500.00 or more | 2 months |
| above zero, under 500.00 | 1 month |
| zero, or no active specialty enrollment | none |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

- 500.00: 2 months. 499.99: 1 month.
- 0.01: 1 month. 0.00: none.
